overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The City had designated fallriverma.org as its official posting site and was mid-transition to fallriverma.gov, and the .org address redirected to an identical page where the notices were posted.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council and Committee posted notice of a November 28 meeting on fallriverma.gov instead of the official fallriverma.org site.
allegations.key_passage: were properly posted when users were automatically redirected from https://fallriverma.org to https://fallriverma.gov.
